classification.difficultyReason: Construct the taught coin-and-die table, then select outcomes satisfying both a coin condition and a numerical condition, including even numbers and numbers below 3. This links routine sample-space construction with favourable-outcome counting over 12 outcomes.

content.prompt: A coin is tossed and a six-sided die is rolled.

children.label: a
children.prompt: List all the outcomes using a table.

answer.worked:
Only $(H,6)$ is favourable, out of 12 equally likely outcomes.
$$P(\text{head and }6)=\frac{1}{12}$$

Only $(T,3)$ is favourable, out of 12 equally likely outcomes.
$$P(\text{tail and }3)=\frac{1}{12}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: A head and an even number

answer.worked:
The favourable outcomes are $(H,2)$, $(H,4)$ and $(H,6)$.
$$\begin{aligned}P(\text{head and even})&=\frac{3}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{4}\end{aligned}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: A tail and a number less than 3

answer.worked:
The favourable outcomes are $(T,1)$ and $(T,2)$.
$$\begin{aligned}P(\text{tail and number less than }3)&=\frac{2}{12}\\&=\frac{1}{6}\end{aligned}$$
